question: The Olympic Games was organised in Asia for the first time in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1964**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first Olympic Games held in Asia were the **1964 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan**.
 
• The 1964 Tokyo Olympics were significant as they marked **Asia's debut as a host continent** for the modern Olympic Games.
 
• Tokyo was originally scheduled to host the 1940 Olympics, but they were canceled due to World War II.
 
• These games were the first to be broadcast internationally via satellite, showcasing a new era of global sports broadcasting.
 
• The 1964 Olympics featured **new technological advancements**, such as the introduction of synthetic running tracks and the use of computers for timing and scoring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Games Background:**

 
 
• The modern Olympic Games were first held in Athens, Greece, in 1896.
 
• The Olympics occur every four years and feature summer and winter editions.
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC), founded in 1894, oversees the organization of the Games.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo 1964 Key Highlights:**
 
 
• Japan emerged as a global power post-World War II, using the Olympics to symbolize its recovery and modernization.
 
• Judo and volleyball were introduced as official Olympic sports for the first time.
 
• The iconic Shinkansen (bullet train) was launched in conjunction with the games to improve infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Asia’s Later Olympics:**
 
 
• After 1964, Asia hosted other Olympics, including Seoul 1988 (South Korea), Beijing 2008 (China), and Tokyo 2020 (delayed to 2021 due to COVID-19).
 
• The Winter Olympics were also hosted in Asia, including Sapporo 1972 and PyeongChang 2018.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Tokyo’s Hosting:**
 
 
• Tokyo's hosting marked Asia's emergence as a key player in international sports.
 
• It showcased Japan's technological and economic resurgence post-war.
 
• The games emphasized global unity, peace, and progress during the Cold War era.
